title: Where, and When
label: ch:mr-where-when
canDo: I can ask where somebody lives and when they are coming, and I can turn any statement I already own into a question by swapping one word and moving nothing.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R38-where-when and ask three questions about one person -- who, where, when -- then tell the two question types apart by whether the voice has to rise.
payoff.note: kuṭhe closes SPINE-ASK-LOCATION, the A1 core node this track had left with no realization at all.
